verdict.rationale: Gecko's docs say it posts a pass/fail check back to GitHub or GitLab so reviewers see security status inline. They also describe a configurable fail-on severity threshold, separating PR-introduced findings from pre-existing ones, a PR security review summary with one-click fixes, and committing fixes directly to the PR branch. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the PR check/comment behavior, and explicit confirmation that review summary comments (not just checks) appear on GitLab merge requests.
